# ring_logger v0.11.5 - Table of Contents

> A ring buffer backend for Elixir Logger with IO streaming

## Pages

- [ring_logger](https://ring-logger.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://ring-logger.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [RingLogger](https://ring-logger.hexdocs.pm/RingLogger.md): This is an in-memory ring buffer backend for the Elixir Logger.
- [RingLogger.Autoclient](https://ring-logger.hexdocs.pm/RingLogger.Autoclient.md): Helper module for `RingLogger.Client` to simplify IEx use
- [RingLogger.Client](https://ring-logger.hexdocs.pm/RingLogger.Client.md): Interact with the RingLogger

- [RingLogger.Viewer](https://ring-logger.hexdocs.pm/RingLogger.Viewer.md): A Terminal UI (TUI) based viewer to browse a snapshot of the RingLogger buffer.
Offers a variety of filtering tools.
